# SPIDER CODEX ULTIME — CANONICAL KNOWLEDGE BASE

Generated: 2026-08-30T19:00:30.914238+00:00

Single canonical SPIDER knowledge file. Pre-2.0 research has been normalized here so legacy GitHub Actions runs and orchestration can be deleted.

**Anti-redundancy rule:** the corpus is the union of the FINAL tree state of every reachable branch/tag snapshot, not every intermediate Git revision. Identical Git blobs are stored once; whitespace-equivalent text blobs are also collapsed. Per-run memory is reproduced only when no durable run snapshot exists. Actions logs are handled separately only for gaps with neither snapshot nor retained run-memory.

**Normalization rule:** every scientific artifact is assigned the same lane/role schema: charter/question → prereg/protocol → result/measurement → report/verdict → audit/gate → state/provenance/context. Generated labels and metric extraction are navigation aids only; the retained source artifact remains authoritative.

## 2. Product/research architecture lessons established by pre-2.0

1. Immutable work-request identity: bind execution and audit to request ID + content hash.
2. Explicit write sets: never stage injected control-plane/evidence files with broad `git add -A`.
3. Transactional inheritance: publication and consumption must be atomic or hash-pinned.
4. Per-item recovery: quarantine bad artifacts without discarding valid siblings.
5. Workflow success is not epistemic success: route on explicit scientific verdicts.
6. Measurement validity precedes scientific interpretation: invalid instruments cannot falsify hypotheses.
7. Product is the terminal objective, but research claims must be resolved before product claims are promoted.

### 4.1 — graph / prereg_protocol — `5c388511a96d8dbd0137a4c76a5c0e790d4389fe`

# PREREGISTRATION — GRAPH LANE CYCLE 3 (GitHub run 32684818422)

Frozen: 2026-08-24, BEFORE any cycle-3 training or evaluation outcome was
observed and BEFORE any cycle-3 mechanism code was written. This file is the
freeze-timing anchor for audit item 17 (`directives/AUDITOR_GRAPH.md`).
Experiments E1–E4 below follow `directives/GRAPH.md` (authoritative). Any code
change after the first composite outcome of this cycle marks every affected
row EXPLORATORY; confirmatory claims may cite only pre-registered rows.

## 0. Scope

One preregistered batch on ONE freshly trained knowledge base (same corpus as
cycle 1: 6 producer tasks over books.toscrape.com + quotes.toscrape.com,
TRAIN_SEQ identical to `graph/run_cycle2.py`). No new sites, no new training
tasks, no LLM consumers. Physics untouched.

## 1. Environment gates (E6, folded into preflight)

Before training: plain-HTTP anonymous probes (urllib, UA SpiderResearchBot/0.1)
of quotes root /page/3/ /page/5/ and books root + fiction/mystery category
pages. Record HTTP status + byte count in the run JSON. Browser-level health
gate (E4): a snapshot is HEALTHY iff `dom_bytes >= 2000` AND
`len(elements) >= 5`; checked at task start and after every goto/reset. An
unhealthy snapshot aborts the run with status `unhealthy_host` (recorded, not
silently retried).

## 2. Frozen scorer and representation (apply to ALL arms identically)

Constants unchanged from cycle 1 frozen design: TAU=0.30, MIN_MATCH=2,
COV_CAP=6, TOPK=3, DF_KEEP=0.6, MIN_SITE_FRAGS=3, CONF_MIN=0.35, seed 20260824
for all RNG. NO threshold may be changed in response to any observed ranking
or outcome this cycle (directive rule).

ONE predeclared tokenizer extension ("handle ordinals explicitly" per E3):
`tokenize()` maps ordinal words to digit tokens symmetrically on query AND
fragment sides: first→1, second→2, third→3, fourth→4, fifth→5 (applied before
stemming; only these five). Motivation: fragment descriptions contain URL-borne
digits ('page', '2'); queries say "second page". This is a representation fix
frozen now; it is NOT tuned against outcomes (none exist yet). Consequence:
cycle-3 desc+kw rows double as the replication arm vs cycle 1 under the new
tokenizer; if they reproduce cycle-1 statuses, comparability is empirically
supported; if not, that is reported as a finding.

## 3. Anchored acceptance predicates (E4)

New matching rule for positive `url_frag` (replaces raw substring):
- Normalize path: lowercase, strip query/fragment.
- If anchor contains '/': match iff path contains "/"+anchor+"/" with both
  delimiters (slash-bounded multi-segment match).
- Else single segment: match iff any path segment, after stripping a trailing
  `_N` numeric suffix and `.html`/`.htm`, equals the anchor.
Traps covered by unit tests BEFORE any live run: 'fiction' must NOT match
/historical-fiction_4/; must match /fiction_10/; 'page/3' must match
/page/3/ and NOT /page/30/; 'in-the-woods' and 'the-shack' product segments;
'page-2' segment equality. `neg_url`, `title_frag`, `el_text` remain as in
cycle 1 (disclosed: neg_url stays substring — its failure mode is a false
rejection, never false acceptance). All cycle-3 composites and X1 use anchored
predicates; training predicates are rebuilt with the same rule.

## 4. Query construction per arm (E1)

For subgoal s: desc = s.desc; kw = " ".join(s.keywords).
- `desc_kw` (cycle-1 parity): query = desc + " " + kw. Exploration ranking
  uses s.keywords exactly as cycle 1 (agentB ignores keywords in _rank by
  construction; verified in code review).
- `desc_only`: query = desc alone. Retrieval gets NO keywords.
  Exploration fallback is UNCHANGED mechanically (consumer agentB's _rank does
  not use keywords), so the two arms differ ONLY through the retrieval query
  string. No other parameter differs between arms.

Primary metric E1 (per pager subgoal eval.c2.page3 / eval.c3.page5 /
eval.c1.page2): memory-solved flag (solved_by contains 'memory') and whether
the candidate list was non-empty; plus end-to-end composite status.
DECISION RULE (directive E1): desc-only solves the pager subgoals → upgrade
ledger wording to "descriptions-only addressing demonstrated"; desc-only
fails → honest state becomes "keyword-assisted retrieval"; fixing moves to
descriptor work NEXT cycle validated on the paraphrase holdout — TAU/MIN_MATCH/
DF must NOT be retuned against this cycle's outcomes. Both modes reported
regardless of direction.

## 5. Loop-permitting iterative graph baseline (E2) — frozen policy

Name: `graphiter`. Knowledge used: stored successful transition edges ONLY
(states/actions/transitions tables; fragment layer never consulted).

AMENDMENT (pre-outcome, same commit series as initial freeze, before ANY
cycle-3 training or evaluation ran): the initially drafted variant keyed
candidate edges to the stored node whose fingerprint equals the live state,
plus a momentum clause. Inspection of the committed cycle-2 store dump showed
this strawmans the baseline BY CONSTRUCTION twice: (a) post-login roots have
structural fingerprints absent from training (auth changes element text), and
(b) no stored edge originates beyond trained prefixes (nothing at page/2+),
so no loop-permitting behavior could ever fire. The frozen definition is
therefore the audit's own sketch ("re-apply best outgoing edge while accept
not yet true"), made precise:

Per subgoal, from entry snapshot:
1. Candidate actions = ALL successful transitions recorded for the consumer's
   current site, deduplicated by (kind, target_sig), frequency summed. No
   state-fingerprint gating anywhere — execution semantics are IDENTICAL to
   fragment replay (live DOM signature resolution), so the comparison isolates
   knowledge PACKAGING (validated sequences + auto-derived descriptions vs
   flat edge multiset), not execution mechanics.
2. Rank candidates by the SAME content-scoring functions as blind retrieval
   (goalsig coverage of query tokens vs tokens(kind|target_sig)), tie-break:
   matched_pairs, edge success-frequency, recency, seeded RNG. NO TAU/MIN_MATCH
   cutoff on edges (thresholds govern whole-fragment candidacy; applying them
   here would re-strawman the baseline).
3. Repeatedly apply the best-ranked candidate while the acceptance predicate
   is false ("iterate"); when an application lands on an already-seen
   fingerprint or has no effect, fall through to the NEXT-ranked candidate;
   unresolved signature / action error → reset to task entry if resets<2,
   else exhaust.
4. Accept-oracle checked after EVERY application (equalized with fragments);
   MAX_APPLICATIONS=6 (=fragment cap); MAX_RESETS=2 (=fragment cap);
   exploration fallback identical.
5. Known disclosed risk: ambiguous bare anchors (e.g. `a|||||` image links)
   resolve arbitrarily in live DOM; identical risk already applies to stored
   fragments (cycle-1 finding F5), so exposure is symmetric.
Ablation `fragntr` (fragment-without-iteration): v6 fragment replay restricted
to ONE application per candidate (no progress-driven iteration, no reset-and-
retry of the same candidate); candidates ≤TOPK; then exploration fallback.
Everything else identical to inherit-blind.

Primary metric E2: end-to-end composite status and per-pager-subgoal memory
solved, for graphiter vs inherit-blind (both under desc_kw AND desc_only) and
fragntr vs inherit.
DECISION RULE (directive E2): graphiter matches fragment condition → the
cycle-1 advantage was policy, not representation; ledger records transition
edges suffice at this depth. Fragment beats graphiter → genuine fragment-layer
value-add (upgrade F1 attribution).

## s4. Mechanism specification (clean-room)

- Embedder: deterministic lexical hashed n-gram vectors, 512 dims, word
  unigrams + adjacent bigrams over `[a-z0-9']+` lowercased tokens,
  sublinear tf (1+ln c), sha1-bucketed features (NEVER process-randomized
  `hash()`), L2-normalized sparse dicts; shared by ALL embedding conditions
  so contrasts isolate scoring, not embedding quality.
- Fragment description text: `" ".join(sorted(description_token_set))`
  exactly as stored (auto-derived tokens incl. post-state URL/title tokens;
  accepted-state id10 anomaly retained per s2).
- State summarizer (contract-faithful deterministic adaptation; reference
  uses one would-be LLM call per novel state): page-kind first-match rules
  (enabled password input -> "login form"; >=12 enabled anchors -> "link
  listing page"; >=2 url path segments and <=5 anchors -> "content detail
  page"; else "general page") + up to 15 verb phrases derived ONLY from
  enabled elements ("open '<label>'" for anchor/button/submit/role=button;
  "type password"; "type into '<name>'" for text/email inputs; "tick
  '<name>'" checkboxes; "choose '<name>'" selects). CONTRACT EXTENSIONS
  frozen here (pre-outcome): (i) verb phrases are sorted lexicographically
  (order stability); (ii) summary ALWAYS includes url_shape tokens; when an
  input[type=password] is enabled it appends "login form present"; when a
  visible logout control exists (same predicate as Store.dynamic_vars
  `_auth_logout_visible`) it appends "logged-in session"; when zero verbs
  are derivable it appends "no enabled actions"; an elements-empty snapshot
  yields "empty page" marker (floor against silent C-degenerates-to-B).
- Canonical cache projection (cache-key AND summary-input identity): sha256
  over JSON of [url_shape, title, auth_flag, SORTED element lines
  tag|type|role|name|cls|text[:24] for enabled elements, forms
  fields/method]. Deliberately EXCLUDED: element index i, x/y coordinates,
  xp paths, href strings, ts_ms, dom hashes — volatile fields must not
  split cache keys across structurally identical visits. Cache misses count
  as WOULD-BE LLM CALLS (predeclared cost metric reported WITH the
  mechanism comparison, never post hoc); hits/fallbacks counted too.
- Scoring: rel = alpha*cos(task_emb,desc_emb) + (1-alpha)*cos(state_emb,
  desc_emb); pool = top max(3k,20)=20 by (rel desc, id asc); greedy MMR
  lambda=0.7 with redundancy=max cos(desc_i,desc_c); k=3 returned; ties
  broken by LOWER fragment id everywhere (deterministic; duplicates make
  tie-break load-bearing — declared).
- Pool saturation declared: 16 fragments <= M=20, so MMR diversity cannot
  bind at this library size; any "MMR did X" language is forbidden this
  cycle.
- Live-KB anchor covariate (CTO carried item, recast per specialist review
  as COVARIATE not gate): at bank build, for every fragment record
  has_entry_anchor = (first step has >=1 successful recorded transition);
  per retrieval event log solved-candidate sig_uniq_in_live (count of live
  DOM matches for its first-step target_sig) and whether the reset entry
  state URL existed. These ride result rows; they gate nothing.

## s8. Metrics, selection procedures, validity statistics

Hard slice := (form in {p1,p2}) OR (ctx != route). Forms desc/p1/p2 from
the role instrument; regime tags: A_sig rows = signature-available; A_ft /
B / C rows = natural-language-consumer.

Clusters (reported separately, NEVER pooled):
AUTH {q.login,q.logout}; PAGER {q.tagp2,q.rootpager,b.page2};
CATEGORY {b.cat,b.hfcat}; OPENBOOK {b.book}; HOME {b.home,q.home};
TAG {q.tag}. Per-cluster expectation matrix from Intel caveats (travels
with interpretation): NO fused-over-task-only advantage expected in
AUTH/PAGER; any advantage should concentrate in region-binding clusters
(CATEGORY/OPENBOOK) under entry shift.

Decision statistic (primary cell): NL-consumer regime x HARD slice x
CONFIRM instrument x INFORMATIVE rows only; PAIRED per-row wins/reversals
of C_final vs B_mmr on retrieved-correct@1, pass-pooled with pass-agreement
(rule: both passes same sign of wins-minus-reversals, else INDETERMINATE).
correct@1 with tau gating: arm output = top1 if top1_score >= tau else
NO-CANDIDATE; hit = output in G(qid).

Alpha selection (DEV only): argmax informative-hard correct@1 (ungated,
dev tau preliminary) between C_a03 and C_a07; tie-break -> alpha=0.7
(the variant closer to baseline = harder to separate = conservative against
the candidate). Ledger records both attempts either way.

Tau selection (DEV only, ONE identical procedure per arm, B and C_final):
grid {0.05..0.60 step 0.05}; objective = maximize dev KNOWN-row top1
coverage subject to ZERO dev UNKNOWN-row false accepts; ties -> smallest
tau; feasibility floors: coverage >= 0.60 AND tau <= max dev known-row
score, else MEASUREMENT_INVALID (degenerate threshold), not a verdict.
Full dev tau x (FA, coverage, hard@1) curves for both arms are committed in
the selection artifact. Confirm-side false accepts are REPORTED OUTCOMES,
never re-tuned.

D_random roles (non-decorative): (i) prints chance-level correct@1 beside
every arm number per cluster; (ii) a cluster entering any claim where
D_random >= 0.7 * B_mmr hard@1 is labeled NON-INFORMATIVE for that claim;
(iii) global validity precondition: B_mmr must exceed D_random on the hard
slice overall, else the whole retrieval stack is VOID (MEASUREMENT_INVALID
branch, not a verdict about fusion); (iv) seed schedule = SEED+qi per row.

INDETERMINATE floors: total informative hard confirm rows >= 15 AND >= 4 in
every cluster entering a claim, else INDETERMINATE (not adopt/falsify).

## s9. Adaptation operationalization (chosen pre-outcome; binds verdict ceiling)

Neither labeled adaptation can be resolved offline (no neural embedder, no
LLM summarizer in this environment). Predeclared operationalizations:

- EMBEDDER survival: UNRESOLVED this cycle (lexical-hash family only).
  Hash-seed variation is explicitly FORBIDDEN as "embedder survival"
  evidence. Ceiling wording consequence below.
- SUMMARIZER survival == state-channel SPECIFICITY battery, run in-store on
  the SAME confirm rows: C_final separates from B on the primary statistic
  AND NONE of C_bat_dummy (constant summary "general page"),
  C_bat_perm (summaries permuted across qids within site, fixed seed),
  C_bat_sonly (score=(1-alpha*)cos(state,desc) alone) also separates from B
  on that statistic. If some battery variant matches C_final's separation,
  the state channel is not specific -> summarizer survival UNRESOLVED.

Verdict branches (map onto the directive's frozen rule):
- ADOPT_SCOPED — primary retrieval separation + primary execution
  separation + battery passed (= summarizer survival resolved) + zero
  confirm false accepts (C_final) + no regression of signature-available
  regime vs incumbent A (execution: median novel-actions of A_std/A_strict
  <= C on commonly solved signature cells; retrieval: A_sig >= C_final
  hard@1 on signature rows). Wording ceiling: adoption of the fused scoring
  layer AS INTEGRATED (lexical-hash embedder + deterministic summarizer);
  neural-embedder and LLM-summarizer survival travel as OPEN limitations on
  every downstream citation. Plain unscoped "ADOPT" is unreachable this
  cycle by construction — declared now.
- FALSIFIED-IN-SETTING — C_final fails to separate from B at retrieval
  level, OR regresses A, OR confirms false accepts. Keep exact addressing;
  retain fused retrieval as NL-consumer option ONLY if C>B holds at
  retrieval level alone; partial patterns never re-branded.
- PARTIAL-NL-OPTION — retrieval separation holds but execution conversion
  fails or battery unresolved.
- INDETERMINATE — evidence floors unmet (s8) or pass-disagreement.
- MEASUREMENT_INVALID — tau degeneracy floors fail, B<=D_random voiding,
  health-gate/skeleton incidents flagged by the zero-token-summary guard,
  or environment instability; two consecutive -> lane BLOCKED (frozen).
- BLOCKED-INSTRUMENT — substrate gate fails BEFORE launch: if calibration
  yields < 15 informative hard rows (any instrument role) or < 4 in every
  one of CATEGORY/OPENBOOK/PAGER/AUTH, the live confirm is NOT launched;
  recorded as instrument starvation, not as mechanism evidence.

Early-stop economy (CTO): if retrieval-level separation FAILS on confirm,
execution runs only the A-regression check cells and stops —
FALSIFIED-IN-SETTING is already reachable without buying B/C execution rows
the rule cannot use.

## s10. Execution-level protocol and primary statistic

Grid: 7 composites (D2Q, D3B, D4B, D4H, D4Q, D5Q, D5B verbatim predicates
from tasks_generalization; ONLY the NL desc channel is swapped to THIS
confirm instrument's desc texts via graph/tasks_fused.py, which refuses to
build if any key is missing and preserves sig/keywords/accept/fills/hint
byte-for-byte) x 4 execution arms (s3) x 2 deterministic passes = 56
planned rows (fewer under early-stop). Byte-restored KB before EVERY run;
evaluation writes nothing (store digest asserted identical pre/post);
UNKNOWN stays UNKNOWN (no ground-truth injection); health gates abort
unhealthy hosts as MEASUREMENT_INVALID-candidates.

Primary execution statistic: paired solved-cell intersection — cells =
(composite, subgoal-position, pass); per arm-pair take cells where BOTH
arms solved the cell in BOTH passes; statistic = median difference in
novel-action count (C minus B; C minus A_std for the signature-regime
regression check); cell count stated beside every number. Secondaries,
closed report-all family (no selection): per-arm per-cluster subgoal
success rates; own-solved-cell averages explicitly labelled "conditioned on
own success — NOT comparable across arms"; reused/novel totals; resets/
recoveries; candidates_tried vs solved_candidate; novelty fraction per
cell. Denominator conventions carry units (rows vs cells vs passes) in
every sentence (audit item 22 discipline).

Pass-count language: n=2 deterministic passes support a DETERMINISM claim
only. Banned words anywhere in report/ledger: "replicated/reliable/robust/
consistent-across-runs" for pass agreement; any CI/sampling language.

1. Battery variants (s9) on confirm rows.
2. Token-provenance decomposition: rescore C_final with desc_prestate

### 6b. Application constraint (unit-tested, uniform for both frag arms)

Mechanism (from recorded events, not from outcomes): on failed fragment
replay the old code re-entered the TASK START region and retried there —
the recorded signature (unresolved abort from mystery p2, then six
applications paginating the ROOT catalogue) is cross-region misbinding.
FROZEN REPLACEMENT in `Explorer._phase_fragments`: on failed replay with
resets<MAX_RESETS, re-enter the candidate's OWN RECORDED ENTRY STATE =
URL of the most recent state with a SUCCESSFUL transition whose action ==
the candidate's FIRST step (`Explorer.entry_state_url_for_first_step`;
deterministic max-transition-id; pure store query). If no such state
exists → retire the candidate immediately (recoveries++, stuck). After
re-entry, if the first step still does not resolve → abort
("unresolved_at_entry") and retire. The task-start rebinding path is
REMOVED for fragment replay. graphiter/traj/cold untouched (graphiter
never had a task-start reset on unresolved edges — verified in code;
equalization note: the constraint is a fragment-layer application rule
applied identically to A1/A2). Unit tests:
tests/test_graph_generalization.py::EntryStateRecoveryTests +
full legacy suite green at this commit. Event field `reset_target`
("entry_state" | "none_retired") added — additive instrumentation,
provenance only.

Both components (6a knowledge coverage for the NEW regions; 6b misbinding
constraint) together constitute THE single P1 repair chosen before any
evaluation row; the analyzer reports per-component evidence (new-candidate

## 9. Analysis plan (frozen; `graph/analyze_generalization.py`)

Recomputed FROM RAW ROWS ONLY. Decision rule — DIRECTIVE TEXT, embedded
VERBATIM (source: `directives/GRAPH.md`, program decision-rule section):

> - **GENERALIZES**: on BOOKS composites (n≥2), at least one inheritance arm
>   achieves memory-led success on ≥half of them in BOTH passes with all
>   reference contrasts holding (references fail or pay strictly more novel
>   actions on the same tasks), AND the quotes stability controls remain
>   memory-led as in G-H5.
> - **SITE-BOUND**: no inheritance arm reaches memory-led success on ANY books
>   depth-≥4 composite while at least one such composite is solvable-evidenced
>   (reference success, or failure attributed per recorded events to
>   compounding resets/entry mismatch) — a bounded negative that completes
>   the program and bounds the product thesis.
> - **BOOKS-INSTRUMENT-UNREPAIRABLE**: P1 fails under its legitimacy boundary
>   with documented evidence.
> - Anything else: report the exact pattern as PARTIAL. The program's decision
>   horizon is reached in EVERY branch after this one preregistered
>   confirmation cycle.

Operationalization (frozen): BOOKS composite set = {D4B, D4H, D5B} (n=3;
n≥2 satisfied); ≥half := ceil(3/2)=2; memory_led(row) := status=="success"
AND reused>novel; qualify(A,C) := memory_led in BOTH passes; reference
contrast per qualifying (A,C,pass) and ref∈{cold,traj}: ref fails OR
novel(ref) > novel(A) on the same task/pass; quotes-stability-as-in-G-H5 :=
frag_v31, frag_legacy AND giter_legacy EACH qualify on BOTH {D4Q,D5Q} with
contrasts holding (giter_v31 reported beside; G-H5 parity expects 0).
solvable-evidenced(C) := cold/traj end-to-end success on C (any pass), OR
recorded events attributing failures to compounding resets/entry mismatch
(recoveries>0 AND loads>=3 on some inheritance row of C, reported with its
events). Depth ladder per task×arm (row convention rows_memory_led/2;
cell convention cells_memory_led/1) WITH achieved-memory-depth classes
beside nominal; mandatory attribution table (unit row×subgoal-event:
solved_by carryover/memory/exploration/unsolved; ADDRESSING-MISS =
empty candidates; EXECUTION-FAIL = candidates present + replay aborted
with abort_step + reset_target field); novel-action cost comparison per
task matched (NO cross-task aggregation); discipline proofs: distinct
store_before==1; store_after==store_before everywhere; final store ==
eval-start; pass1==pass2 per cell on status/action counts/solved_by;
health events; probes. Denominators ALWAYS carry units; never silently
conditioned on success. n=2 deterministic passes = replication, NOT
sampling uncertainty.

## s4. Mechanism specification — INDUCED KEYS RULES v1 (frozen)

Inputs (consumer-legitimate recorded data ONLY): fragment `steps`
(kind; target_sig `tag|type|role|name|cls|slugtext`), fragment `site`,
and the committed transition/state tables of the SAME rebuilt DB. FORBIDDEN
as inputs: `goal_sig` (producer-side bookkeeping — mechanically asserted
absent from all emitted tokens, see tests), page_text, raw DOM snapshots,
wall-clock, confidence values.

Tokenization primitive: `goalsig.tokenize` (lowercase alnum, STOPWORDS out,
ordinal words -> digits BEFORE stemming, crude deterministic stem) reused
UNMODIFIED so both arms' vocabularies live in one representation space.

- R1 AFFORDANCE (all variants). Steps in stored order. Per step emit:
  (a) verb-expansion map by kind — click -> {click, open, select};
      fill -> {fill, enter, type}; submit_enter -> {submit};
      check -> {check, tick}; select -> {choose, select} (closed map,
      predeclared; closes the auto-desc gap where queries say open/sign in/
      enter while stored tokens say click/fill);
  (b) label tokens: tokenize() over ALL six target_sig fields (tag, type,
      role, name, cls, slug text) IN FIELD ORDER, then the slug-text words
      REPEATED once more in original order immediately after, so the hash
      embedder's adjacent-bigram mechanism forms phrase features over the
      affordance label (sorted-set join destroys adjacency; THIS ORDERED
      EMISSION IS PART OF THE TREATMENT and is disclosed as such);
  (c) R1b DIGIT<->ORDINAL expansion (key side only): applied ONCE over the
      FULL assembled token sequence BEFORE final dedupe, so every emitted
      digit d in 1..5 — from step labels AND from R2/R3 URL paths alike —
      inserts its ordinal word immediately after it (e.g. '2' -> 'second').
      Queries are NEVER transformed. (In the s11 class projections, R1b is
      applied inside the AFF class only; ENTRY/EFF stay raw path tokens.)
- R2 REGION-OF-ENTRY (K_reg, K_full). SITE-SCOPED deterministic join:
  SELECT s.url FROM transitions t JOIN actions a ON a.id=t.action_id
  JOIN states s ON s.id=t.from_state WHERE t.outcome='success'
  AND s.site = <fragment.site> AND a.kind=<step0.kind>
  AND a.target_sig=<step0.target_sig> ORDER BY t.id DESC LIMIT 1.
  The site predicate is MANDATORY (specialist finding: the unscoped join
  assigns books URLs to quotes pager fragments). URL path tokens:
  urlsplit path split on '/', '-', '_', '.'; tokenize(); EXCLUDE netloc
  tokens entirely; EXCLUDE structural suffixes {'index', 'html'};
  dedupe preserving first occurrence. Join multiplicity (#distinct
  successful entry states matching within site) recorded to the manifest;
  selection never uses it.
- R3 EFFECT (K_full only). Last step -> to_state URL via the same
  site-scoped join pattern; identical token rules as R2.

Variants: K_aff = R1+R1b; K_reg = K_aff+R2; K_full = K_reg+R3.
Key text = ordered whitespace join of the emitted token sequence (NOT
sorted-set — order preservation is declared treatment, see R1b). Rule
version hash: sha256 over canonical sort-keys JSON of the RULES object
(maps, exclusions, join SQL template, field order, ordinal map) computed by
`induced_keys.rules_hash()`; recorded in the manifest beside derived keys so
an auditor can recompute offline byte-for-byte.

Determinism requirements (tested): two independent rebuilds into fresh DBs
yield byte-equal derived-keys JSON; no dict-order, PYTHONHASHSEED,
wall-clock or float-format dependence in emission (sha1 buckets handle the
only float-adjacent step downstream inside the UNMODIFIED embedder).
`Store.all_fragments()` gains a contractual `ORDER BY id` (verified
legacy-identical on this KB; locks row order against sqlite plan changes).

Identical-machinery pins: A_keys must reproduce the accepted G-H7 baseline
bank bit-identically (digest equality unit test); B_keys differs from A_keys
ONLY in the description strings handed to the same `FragmentBank`; embedder,
pool, MMR, tie-breaks, tau grid/procedure and D_random schedule are the
UNTOUCHED `graph/fused_retrieval.py` / `graph/fused_eval.py` code.

Known asymmetries disclosed IN ADVANCE (predeclared, monitored in s11):
induced keys are LONGER and differently-canonicalized than auto descs;
lexical-hash cosine geometry is length-sensitive; the digit<->ordinal rule
expands key-side vocabulary toward query phrasing. These are part of the
treatment being tested (richer keys), not confounds to remove; the s11
decomposition and length diagnostics quantify which component carries any
separation.

## s8. Metrics, selection procedures, validity statistics — PINNED READINGS

Hard slice := (form in {p1,p2}) OR (ctx != route). Forms desc/p1/p2 from the
role instrument. Informative := 0 < |G(qid)| <= floor(16/2)=8.
Regime tags: A_sig rows = signature-available; A_ft / A_keys / B_keys rows =
natural-language-consumer.

PRIMARY READING (declared in-prereg per directive): TAU-GATED hard-slice
retrieved-correct@1, paired per-row B_keys vs A_keys, restricted to
INFORMATIVE-hard CONFIRM rows, **abstention counted as miss** (an arm that
abstains where the other hits loses that pair; double-abstention and
double-hit rows are non-decisive). SEPARATION := exact one-sided binomial
sign test over decisive pairs, p <= 0.05, AND decisive-pair count >= 15
(below 15 decisive pairs the statistic is INDETERMINATE, never falsified).
Per-pass statistics reported identically (pass 1 and pass 2 separately);
passes are NEVER pooled into n=122; PASS AGREEMENT rule: both passes show
the same sign of wins-minus-reversals, else the primary is INDETERMINATE.
Rationale (pre-outcome): G-H7 demonstrated the gated family can degenerate
to universal abstention (0–0 over 61 rows); abstention-as-miss makes the
gated pairing decisive whenever EITHER arm outputs, and the sign-test
predicate retires G-H7's brittle `wins>0 ∧ reversals==0` rule (null risk
12.5% at m=3 yet 100%-domination demand at large m).

SECONDARY READING (co-reported; direction-consistency REQUIRED for ADOPT):
ALL-UNGATED retrieved-correct@1 on the same informative-hard slice, same
pairing conventions minus gating (top-1 always output when ranked list
non-empty; empty-list rows count as miss).

FOUR-WAY CONVENTION PARITY (auditor item 29): every verdict-driving
statistic is additionally recounted under {gated, ungated} x {hard slice,
all instances} with denominator labels INSIDE the analysis JSON blocks; if
any verdict-driving statistic is ambiguous across defensible readings, ALL
readings are recounted and the committed verdict must be invariant or be
honestly downgraded. Denominators carry units (rows / pairs / cells /
passes) in every sentence.

Tau procedure (DEV only, ONE identical procedure per arm, A_keys and the
advancing B_keys variant): fixed grid TAU_GRID={0.05..0.60 step 0.05};
objective = maximize DEV known-row top1 coverage subject to ZERO DEV
unknown-row false accepts; ties -> smallest tau; feasibility check tau <=
max dev known-row score else MEASUREMENT_INVALID-by-instrument (degenerate).
NO coverage floor (A2 precedent). Full dev tau x (FA, coverage, gated
hard@1, ungated hard@1) curves for BOTH arms committed in the selection
artifact. Confirm-side false accepts are REPORTED OUTCOMES, never re-tuned.

FALSE-ACCEPT ANALYSIS (expected-UNKNOWN discipline): (i) zero CONFIRM gated
false accepts at the dev-chosen taus is an ADOPT requirement for BOTH text
arms; (ii) because the unknown family is SMALL (single expected-UNKNOWN qid
family; n disclosed in every block — G-H7 precedent ~3 rows), every FA
number carries that n beside it; (iii) full known-vs-unknown absolute-score
distributions per arm (max/min/median) are reported so a reader can see
whether ANY zero-FA operating point exists at nonzero coverage; (iv) the
UNGATED top-1 output on unknown rows is reported as a distributional fact,
not a pass/fail gate (ungated acceptance is vacuous-by-construction).

D_random roles (non-decorative): (i) chance-level correct@1 printed beside
every arm number PER CLUSTER (clusters never pooled); (ii) a cluster
entering a claim where D_random >= 0.7 * the weaker text arm's hard@1 is
labeled NON-INFORMATIVE for that claim; (iii) global validity precondition:
A_keys must exceed D_random on the hard slice overall (ungated-by-
construction random; A_keys compared UNGATED for this precondition — the
comparison semantics are pinned HERE, before outcomes, closing G-H7's
disclosed ambiguity class), else the whole retrieval stack is VOID
(MEASUREMENT_INVALID branch, not a verdict about keys); (iv) implemented
seed schedule QUOTED VERBATIM (auditor item 30): rows are enumerated by
`enumerate_queries` sorted by qid string, forms in order ('desc','p1','p2');
the D_random rng for row index i is `random.Random(FR.SEED * 31 + i)` with
FR.SEED=20260825 (`fused_eval.score_rows`/`raw_rankings`); the in-function
fallback `random.Random(_seed_for(row['qid']))` (sha1 of qid) exists in
`rank_arm` but is unreachable from this program's drivers because they
always pass rng for D_random. No other randomness exists anywhere in the
program (embedder sha1-bucketed; MMR/tau/induction deterministic).

RECALL@POOL (candidate generation vs ordering, CTO-5 item 2 lesson):
recall@pool = fraction of slice rows whose truth set intersects the top-M
pool. At N=16 fragments <= M=20 the pool IS the site library, so recall@pool
== recall@library == fraction of rows with non-empty truth; this is STATED
inside every analysis block carrying it, so an ordering loss can never be
misattributed to candidate generation. Reported separately from rank@1 for
both text arms on hard-informative rows.

before any observation):

| decisive m | min wins | exact p | required dominance |
|---|---|---|---|
| 10 | 9  | 0.01074 | 0.90 |
| 15 | 12 | 0.01758 | 0.80 |

Expected decisive yield: G-H7's informative-hard n was 61; near-chance text
arms historically produce ~35–50% decisive fractions (m≈21–31), i.e.
12–20 wins needed — decidable IF a real effect exists; a null effect yields
neither separation nor regression cleanly, which maps to FALSIFIED-IN-
SETTING with attribution (not INDETERMINATE) provided floors are met.

## s9. Verdict branches (map onto the directive's frozen decision rule)

- BLOCKED_INSTRUMENT — s7 substrate gate fails before launch.
- MEASUREMENT_INVALID — health/skeleton incidents on canonical runs;
  tau-procedure degeneracy (no feasible zero-FA tau for an arm => that
  arm's gated reading VOID-by-instrument); A_keys<=D_random voiding
  precondition. Handling exactly as G-H7: disclose verbatim, never resolve
  post hoc; verdict must be shown outcome-invariant across defensible
  readings (four-way recount) or downgraded honestly. PREDECLARED
  VOID-GATE BRANCH (declared now, pre-outcome): if gated readings void by
  instrument degeneracy, the decision falls to the SECONDARY ungated
  reading with all other gates unchanged and every adoption wording capped
  'gated-void'; this branch cannot manufacture separation, it prevents a
  degenerate threshold family from burning the horizon. Two consecutive
  MEASUREMENT_INVALID from environment instability stop the lane BLOCKED.
- ADOPT_SCOPED — primary separates (s8) AND secondary direction-consistent
  (wins>=reversals) AND execution conversion (s10: >=1 common cell AND
  median novel diff B_keys−A_keys < 0) AND zero confirm gated false accepts
  for BOTH text arms at chosen taus AND no signature-regime regression (s10)
  AND pass agreement. Adoption wording ceiling: covers the natural-language-
  consumer regime UNDER the lexical-hash machinery, this KB/library scale
  and these rule versions ONLY; exact goal_sig addressing stays standard for
  signature consumers; no LLM-consumer, cross-model or cross-site option is
  licensed. WORDING CAPS from s11 decomposition: if primary separation
  vanishes on the AFF-only projection (or reverses) while surviving pooled,
  adoption wording caps at 'destination-name lexical matching' — no
  affordance-induction claim; ties/duplicates recounts (s11) must be
  sign-invariant else the verdict is downgraded one evidentiary step with
  the discrepancy reported.
- FALSIFIED-IN-SETTING — primary fails to separate (floors met), OR
  incumbent regression, OR confirm false accepts > 0. Recorded WITH the
  mandated attribution separating EMPTY-CANDIDATE (recall@pool losses) vs
  BAD-ORDERING (recall@pool ok, rank@1 lost) vs EMBEDDER/STACK-CEILING
  (oracle diagnostic also fails on dev) vs REPRESENTATION-GEOMETRY
  (compression diagnostics fire: median top1−top2 margin collapse >75% or
  pairwise-cos>0.9 tail >3x A_keys). Keys stay auto-derived; partial
  patterns never re-branded as adoption.
- INDETERMINATE — decisive pairs < 15, per-cluster floor breach in a claim
  cluster, or pass disagreement.

The decision horizon is reached in EVERY branch after this ONE preregistered
confirmatory cycle. Embedder-survival beyond lexical-hash, library-scale,
route-record and summarizer follow-ups require their OWN successor
preregistrations with fresh instruments — none is a rescue round here.

Early-stop economy: NONE this cycle (G-H7's unexercised clause lesson) —
the full 48-row execution grid runs regardless of retrieval outcome so the
conversion and regression gates are always measured.

## s10. Execution-level protocol and primary statistic

Grid: 6 composites (D3B, D4B, D4H, D4Q, D5Q, D5B — D2Q EXCLUDED per the
upstream A1 rationale carried verbatim: pre-eval.* sigs and a page-3 pager
position with no honest description in the instruments; disclosed stability-
control loss) x 4 execution arms (A_strict, A_std, A_keys, B_keys) x 2
deterministic passes = 48 rows. ONLY the NL desc channel swaps to THIS
program's confirm instrument (`graph/tasks_keys.py` refuses to build on a
missing key and asserts every non-desc subgoal field byte-identical to the
upstream definitions). Byte-restored KB before EVERY run (stats digest
asserted {19,29,15,16}); evaluation writes NOTHING (store stats equal
pre/post); UNKNOWN stays UNKNOWN (no ground-truth injection); health gates
abort unhealthy hosts as MEASUREMENT_INVALID-candidates; chunked incremental
writes prevent runner-timeout corruption; chunks planned up-front, observed
rows never re-run.

Primary execution statistic (G-H7 s10 definition verbatim): paired solved-
cell intersection — cells = (composite, subgoal-position, pass); per arm
pair, cells solved by BOTH arms in BOTH passes; statistic = median
difference in novel_delta (B_keys minus A_keys; conversion gate n_cells>=1
AND median<0). Signature-regime regression checks: signed medians
A_std−B_keys and A_strict−B_keys on commonly solved cells; regression =
median > 0 with n_cells>=1 (zero common cells = check vacuous, disclosed).
Secondaries, closed report-all family: per-arm memory-led end-to-end counts
(all subgoals solved AND reused>novel); per-cluster subgoal success;
own-solved-cell averages LABELED conditioned-on-own-success (never
cross-arm comparable); reused/novel/load totals; resets/recoveries;
candidates_tried; novelty fraction per cell. Denominator units in every
sentence. Pass-count language: n=2 deterministic passes support a
DETERMINISM claim only; banned: replicated/reliable/robust/
consistent-across-runs for pass agreement; any CI/sampling language.

## 1. Question (verbatim from directives/GRAPH.md)

Can deterministic COMPILERS turn already-committed transition dumps into
ordered, executable, browser-primitive-level procedures that achieve
memory-led end-to-end success on composites where fragment-based
inheritance fails — especially the BOOKS depth>=4 chains — at FEWER novel
actions than budget-bounded fragment consumption, WITHOUT any silent
substitution (every unresolvable step surfaces as transparent novelty,
never fabricated success)?

## 3. Design summary (knowledge-FORM contrast)

Independent variable = FORM OF INHERITED KNOWLEDGE: ordered procedures
consumed directly vs fragments consumed by iterative text-addressed
retrieval vs unordered edge multisets. Addressing is NOT the variable:
procedure consumption is intent-keyed by the PUBLIC task specification
(subgoal order + acceptance predicates) exactly as every arm receives it;
this is disclosed as exact-intent keying (A_strict precedent), not a
semantic-addressing claim. The benchmark's CLASS MAPS never enter
compilation: units are induced from dump sessions only (s4); the composite
ladder is consulted ONLY at post-hoc assembly/matching, which is the same
public information every arm consumes.

## 4. Compiler family (frozen rules; induction is benchmark-free)

- Context classes: frozen mechanical function `url_template_class_v2`
  (host + normalized path segments; `page-<n>` kept as `PAGE-<n>`;
  trailing `_<digits>` slugs -> CAT when directly after segment `books`,
  else ITEM; structural tokens catalogue/category/books/tag/login/page
  kept; other literals -> ITEM; empty path -> ROOT). Disclosed aliasings
  (CAT identity collapse; ITEM mega-class; quotes ROOT conflates auth
  states) travel with every citation; auth state is
  `unrecoverable_offline` (URLs cannot encode sessions; legacy states
  carry no dynamic_vars), which is WHY quotes procedures are expected to
  be declared-absent rather than silently session-blind.

- UNIT INDUCTION (identical for all rules, dump-only): for each producing
  task (`task_id`), take its successful transitions ordered by transition
  id and segment into MAXIMAL SIMPLE RUNS — maximal contiguous
  sub-sequences whose from/to STATE URL sequence never revisits a URL —
  yielding units `{unit_id, site, steps:[{kind,target_sig,value?}],
  entry_state, exit_state, entry_class, exit_class, exemplar_from_url,
  exemplar_to_url, support_transition_ids, producing_task_id}`. Unit ids
  assigned deterministically (site, then lowest transition id). Fills
  carry values sourced ONLY from fragment steps JSON (lowest fragment id
  with a value for the same kind+target_sig; `value_source` recorded).

- ASSEMBLY (post-hoc matching to the public task spec): walk composite
  subgoals IN ORDER maintaining current region (start =
  url_template_class_v2(task start)). For each unsatisfied subgoal, choose
  an applicable unit (same site; entry_class == current region), simulate
  region advance along its exit_class, evaluate that subgoal's acceptance
  predicate against the chosen unit's exemplar landing URL. Repeat until
  all positions covered or no applicable unit exists. Assembly tie-break:
  (a) unit whose exemplar landing satisfies the CURRENT subgoal accept,
  else (b) region-progressing units, then support size desc, raw-backed
  from-state preference, lowest unit id.

Rules screened (variant-attempt ledger; ALL gate outcomes exported):

- `R1_exact_instance`: instance-exact chaining only — every step's
  recorded from_url must equal the previous step's recorded to_url from
  the task start URL. Quantifies the inventory gap.
- `R2_region_library`: observed-departure grounding only — every step must
  belong to a unit OBSERVED departing the required context class.
- `R2b_region_library_sibstruct`: R2 PLUS SIBLING-STRUCTURAL fallback,
  allowed ONLY when (i) the exact (kind,target_sig) has >=1 successful
  observed departure SOMEWHERE on the same site (effect observed), and
  (ii) a RAW-BACKED recorded state whose url_template_class == current
  region carries that target ENABLED (directive validity wording: "target
  exists in the recorded step context"), and (iii) landing region declared
  from an exemplar edge of the same signature when one exists, else
  `UNKNOWN_OFFLINE` (assembly stops, reports incomplete), and (iv) the
  step is labeled `sib_structural` with witnesses {witness_state_id,
  class_member_urls, n_enabled_matches, exemplar_transition_id}.
- `R3_text_intent`: dev-instrument description-token addressing over units
  (goalsig token overlap >=1 matched pair; ties lowest unit id). Uses only
  the dev instrument spent-after-P0; disclosed weakest key.

## 5. Offline validity gates (mechanical, pass/fail, every rule)

- G_TYPE: every assembled step type-checks against recorded affordances —
  OBSERVED tier (successful recorded departure from required context
  class) or SIBLING-STRUCTURAL tier per s4 constraints. TEXT_INTENT-only
  grounding FAILS G_TYPE by definition.
- G_COMP: procedure COMPLETE for the target subgoal chain — every position
  covered, every fill valued, no placeholder/hole, final landing satisfies
  the LAST subgoal accept on its exemplar URL.
- G_COHERENCE: chain-consistency replay — re-simulate the assembled chain;
  each unit's entry_class must equal the accumulated region (internal
  consistency; deliberately NOT instance connectivity, which would reduce
  compilation to R1).
- G_CONTAM: adjacent-pair absence OVER THE COMPILED PROCEDURE relative to
  EVERY evaluation composite at BOTH currencies: (C1-instance) no single
  producing task records the ordered action pairs realizing two ADJACENT
  composite positions (consecutive OR ordered-non-consecutive within the
  task, both readings reported); (C1-class) same at class-pair currency
  over adjacent ladder classes; (C2) consecutive assembled blocks citing
  shared producing tasks reported — contamination iff the shared task also
  exhibits the C1 adjacency on that pair; (C3) procedure action multiset
  != any single producing task's multiset (multiset equality = replay);
  (CONCAT) cross-attempt concatenation scan over all cited-task pairs
  (auditor item 28 pattern) recorded as advisory with risk direction.
  Contamination verdict = C1-full-chain-single-task OR C3-failure OR
  (C2-shared AND C1-adjacent-on-that-pair).
- Supply matrix published for every composite x position REGARDLESS of
  branch (exact-instance edge count, observed-required-class count,
  sibling-structural witness availability, any-site count).
- Failure taxonomy per rule x composite: no-complete-procedure vs
  incomplete (first unsupported position) vs invalid-step vs contaminated.

## 6. P0->P1 gate + frozen rule selection

Proceed to live IFF >=1 rule produces COMPLETE (G_COMP) VALID
(G_TYPE+G_COHERENCE) CONTAMINATION-CLEAN (G_CONTAM) procedures covering
>=1 currently-failing composite class (BOOKS depth>=4). Otherwise program
COMPLETES FALSIFIED-IN-SETTING for the tested compiler family at zero
live cost with ledger+taxonomy.

RULE SELECTION (frozen NOW, mechanical, outcome-independent): among rules
passing all gates on >=1 failing-class target prefer (1) fewest
sib_structural steps summed over gated failing-class procedures, then
(2) fewest total steps, then (3) rule name ascending. Only the selected
rule enters the live phase; sensitivity variants are report-only.

# PREREGISTRATION — graph-procedure-compilation P0

**Program**: graph-procedure-compilation
**Cycle**: 1 (Run 33109357359)
**Author**: graph_runner
**Date**: 2026-08-27
**Status**: FROZEN before any P0 outcome

## 1. Question

Can deterministic COMPILERS turn committed transition dumps into ordered,
executable, browser-primitive-level procedures that achieve memory-led
end-to-end success on composites where fragment-based inheritance fails
(BOOKS depth≥4: D4B, D4H, D5B)?

## 2. Knowledge-form contrast

This is materially distinct from all completed programs:
- G-H6 varied site/inventory
- G-H7 varied the scoring layer
- G-H8 varied the key/description representation

Here the independent variable is the artifact form: ordered procedures
consumed directly, compiled OFFLINE from committed producer-era dumps.

## 3. P0 scope — Offline compilation grid (NO live rows)

### 3.1 Input

- Committed KB dump: `results/graph/generalization_growth_kb_dump.json.gz`
  (19 states, 29 transitions, 15 actions, 16 fragments)
- Evaluation composites: D4B, D4H, D5B from `tasks_generalization.py`
- Fragment step format: `{kind, target_sig, value?}`
- Transition format: `[id, from_state, action_id, to_state, outcome, ...]`

### 3.2 Compiler rules (variant-attempt ledger)

| Rule ID | Description | Chaining method |
|---------|-------------|-----------------|
| CR-1 | Direct state-fingerprint chaining | Match to_state FP of transition A to from_state FP of transition B |
| CR-2 | Action-signature chaining | Match action target_sig in procedure to action target_sig in store |
| CR-3 | Fragment-sequence compilation | Order existing fragments by subgoal dependency, concatenate steps |
| CR-4 | BFS path enumeration | Find shortest path through transition graph from start to each subgoal accept state |

### 3.3 Offline validity gates (pass/fail, mechanical)

For every compiled procedure:
1. **Step type-check**: every step's `kind` ∈ {click, fill, submit_enter, check, select}
2. **Affordance check**: every step's `target_sig` exists in the recorded transition that produced the from_state
3. **Completeness**: procedure covers ALL subgoals of the target composite (no placeholder/hole)
4. **Provenance**: each step records which dump row(s) it came from
5. **No fabrication**: every step is derived from a committed transition; no invented steps

### 3.4 Contamination test

A compiled procedure containing an evaluation composite's full
adjacent-pair chain is route replay, not compilation.

Test: for each compiled procedure P and each evaluation composite C:
- Extract adjacent pairs from C's subgoal chain
- Check if ANY consecutive step pair in P matches a consecutive transition pair in C
- If match found: procedure is CONTAMINATED

Plus cross-attempt concatenation clause: test over source dumps'
producing sessions (not just individual trajectories).

### 3.5 Strong nulls

- **Shuffled-order**: same step multiset, randomized order (Fisher-Yates, seed=42)
  - If shuffled order matches memory-led success: ordering is NOT the active ingredient
- **Edge-set replay**: unordered set of transitions (no ordering guarantee)
- **Fragment-consumption reference**: auto-derived descriptions under frozen baseline machinery
- **Exact-sig incumbents**: A_strict/A_std as execution references

### 3.6 Failure taxonomy

| Code | Meaning |
|------|---------|
| no-complete-procedure | No compiler rule produces a complete procedure for any failing composite |
| incomplete | Procedure exists but has holes (missing subgoal coverage) |
| invalid-step | Procedure step fails type-check or affordance check |
| contamination | Procedure contains eval composite's adjacent-pair chain |
| kb-supply-gap | Failure due to missing transitions in KB, not compilation logic |

### 3.7 P0→P1 gate

Proceed to LIVE confirmatory cycle ONLY IF:
- At least one compiler rule produces COMPLETE, VALID, contamination-clean procedures
- Covering ≥1 currently-failing composite class (BOOKS depth≥4)

If NO rule does: program COMPLETES FALSIFIED-IN-SETTING for the tested
compiler family at zero live cost.

## 4. Power/supply arithmetic

- Failing composites: D4B, D4H, D5B (3 composites)
- Required: ≥1 complete valid contamination-clean procedure per composite
- Available transitions: 29 total, BOOKS-domain: ~12
- Subgoal chains needed: D4B (4 steps), D4H (4 steps), D5B (5 steps)
- Each step requires a matching transition in the KB

## 5. Decision rule (P0 only)

- **PASS to P1**: ≥1 compiler rule produces complete valid contamination-clean procedures for ≥1 BOOKS depth≥4 composite
- **FALSIFIED-IN-SETTING**: no compiler rule produces complete procedures (failure taxonomy recorded)
- **MEASUREMENT_INVALID**: code/data error invalidates the grid (disclosed verbatim)

## 6. Deviations from this prereg

Any deviation after freeze must be disclosed in report deviations section
with statistics-neutrality argument.

## 3. Closed variant family — COMPLETE AND CLOSED AT THIS COMMIT

A variant = (descriptor function d, query function q). Descriptor functions
map a fragment's stored description token set (from the dump) to an enriched
set. Query functions map query text to a token set. Matching, thresholds,
df-pruning, candidate caps, ranking order and tie-breaks (coverage, net,
last_validated, seeded RNG) are the UNCHANGED frozen cycle-3 machinery for
every arm. Canonical constant tokens are uppercase (CAT/LIST/NEXT/AUTH/GO/
HOME/ENTRY/1../20) and can never collide with corpus stems.

### 3a. Descriptor functions (applied symmetrically to every fragment of both sites)

- d0_base: stored tokens verbatim (frozen reference).
- d1_dechrome: d0 minus closed chrome set
  {www, http, https, com, net, org, toscrape, scrape, sandbox,
   html, htm, index, php}
  (generic web host/file chrome; list fixed a priori, not derived from any
  score; class: URL-anchor token handling).
- d2_ordpos: d0 plus, for each 1-based step position i<=6 of the fragment:
  {ordinal_word(i), decimal(i)} with ordinal_word in the closed list
  {first, second, third, fourth, fifth, sixth} (class: positional encoding).
- d3_pagelist: d0 plus canonical token LIST iff ('page' is in d0) AND (at
  least one pure-digit token is in d0) — content-derived detection of the
  page-anchor + depth-digit pattern marking pagination-affordance knowledge
  (class: anchor-token enrichment).
- d4_entryctx: d0 plus canonical token HOME iff the fragment's FIRST step
  target_sig equals the target_sig of any successful transition whose
  from_state is a ROOT state of the same site (root state := stored state of
  that site whose normalized path is '/' or '/index.html'; joinable purely
  from dump states+transitions). Class: entry-context descriptor.

### 3b. Query/tokenizer functions (applied SYMMETRICALLY to query text and to the descriptor token set of the SAME arm)

Base pipeline (unchanged): lowercase alnum tokens -> drop STOPWORDS ->
ORDINALS{first..fifth -> 1..5} -> crude stem; prefix-equivalence for tokens
of length >=4 (goalsig._eq).

- q0_plain: exactly the frozen pipeline (reference).
- q1_canon: additionally maps whole tokens through this closed table
  BEFORE stemming (both sides):
  GO     <- {go, goto, navigate, browse, jump, open, show, display,
             bring, view, visit, walk, move, head, return, back}
  NEXT   <- {next, forward, advance, following, more}
  CAT    <- {category, section, catalog, catalogue, genre, shelf,
             department}
  LIST   <- {list, listing, listings, pagination}
  AUTH   <- {login, log, signin, sign, authenticate, authentication,
             auth, credentials}
  HOME   <- {home, main, start, beginning, front, frontpage, homepage,
             landing}
  Deliberately NOT mapped (declared): product(s)/item(s)/novel/title/book —
  protecting expected-UNKNOWN named-book queries from pagination false
  accepts.
- q2_orddigit: replaces ORDINALS with its union
  {one..twenty -> 1..20} (digit words; symmetric both sides;
  class: positional/ordinal token handling).

## 7. R3 protocol (login residual-value ablation; RF-3)

Question (directive): is the measured fragment login-packaging residual
procedural structure or fill-ordering accident?

Arms, all else equalized (oracle accept-check after every application,
MAX_APPLICATIONS=6, MAX_RESETS=2, identical exploration fallback,
evaluation=True, byte-restored KB, health gates, agentB, desc_kw):
- r3_frag: condition inherit desc_kw (fragment packaging; replicates the
  cycle-3 E2 rows).
- r3_graphiter: condition graphiter desc_kw (flat edge multiset, dynamic
  single-edge iteration; replicates cycle-3 E2 rows).
- r3_edgeseq: NEW condition defined NOW, frozen: candidates = ALL successful
  site edges deduped by (kind,target_sig) (graph_iter.site_edges), ranked
  ONCE per subgoal by graph_iter.rank_edges on the subgoal query (same
  scoring, no tau/min_match cutoff); ONE application = replay the ranked
  list IN ORDER, each edge AT MOST ONCE per application, skipping edges
  unresolvable in the live DOM; fills/checks execute once per application;
  accept-oracle checked after EVERY edge execution; action error -> reset to
  task entry if resets<2 else exhaust; no-effect/revisit steps do not abort
  the pass (they simply do not advance); after MAX_APPLICATIONS ordered
  passes without acceptance -> exploration fallback. Difference vs
  graphiter isolated: STATIC committed ordering replayed as a unit vs
  DYNAMIC best-edge iteration; difference vs r3_frag isolated: edge multiset
  ordering vs VALIDATED contiguous step sequence.

Tasks: full composites C2_quotes_login_p3 and C3_quotes_login_p5 (their
login subgoal is the object; full-composite context identical to cycle-3),
2 passes each arm -> 12 rows. Primary metric: login-subgoal memory-solved
per ROW (all rows regardless of end-to-end status), also reported as
conditionxtask CELLS (n=2). End-to-end statuses reported alongside.
Raw rows -> `results/graph/robustness_r3_runs.json`.

Interpretation grid (predeclared): frag solves / flat arms fail -> packaging
value is the VALIDATED ORDER (procedural structure beyond flat ranking);
edgeseq solves too -> validated sequence adds nothing over ranked-edge unit
replay (ordering accident); graphiter solves too -> even dynamic iteration
suffices (contradicts cycle-3 E2 login rows — would demand replication
before any ledger claim).

login-packaging findings; V31 selection-on-instrument caveat); (iii) the
committed READ-ONLY affordance inventory
`results/graph/scaling_affordance_inventory.json` (environment
characterization only; it contains no outcome of any growth or evaluation
task). The SAME team session co-designed growth tasks and evaluation
composites; this is inherent to a natural-growth design and is mitigated
mechanically: composites are frozen HERE first, growth tasks are closed
lists (section 5), the adjacent-pair gates of section 6 are computed from
recorded marker vectors, and no growth or evaluation row exists at this
commit. Category-channel brokenness (df-pruning kills the CAT anchor,
G-H4) was KNOWN and is exploited as a disclosed expectation, not discovered
post hoc (section 4.6).

## 1. Question and hypothesis space

Directive question (verbatim): as required distinct-fragment chain depth
grows past the accepted frontier (>3), does inheritance keep paying —
memory-led success with reused>novel actions at depth >=4 under both
fragment and graphiter policies with V31 as standard equipment — or does it
collapse against cold/reference baselines?

Competing mechanisms the measurement must separate (attribution duty):
(a) compounding of per-subgoal addressing misses (empty candidate lists);
(b) execution/replay failures with candidates present;
(c) reset/entry-context cascades;
(d) oracle/budget exhaustion;
(e) exploration fallback cost dominating reused actions.
The analysis plan (section 9) makes these mutually distinguishable from raw
rows. NO claim beyond this scope is licensed.

## 2. Frozen knowledge base

Base KB = committed audited cycle-3 dump
`results/graph/cycle3_20260824_043334_store_dump.json.gz`
(14 states / 19 transitions / 13 actions / 12 fragments), reconstructed by
`graph/rebuild_store.py` semantics (AMENDMENT-A1 timestamps).

GROWTH adds EXACTLY the fragments validated by the section-5 producer tasks
(expected: `quotes.home`, `quotes.logout`, `books.home`; plus whatever
revalidations occur — see disclosure below). The grown KB is dumped once to
`results/graph/scaling_growth_kb_dump.json.gz` (+ manifest with per-task
provenance) and becomes the ONLY KB for all evaluation runs. Evaluation
restores those bytes before EVERY run.

DISCLOSED revalidation effect: growth task GQ2 re-executes the login
procedure under the EXISTING sig `quotes.login`, which increments its
success_count (1 -> 2) and refreshes last_validated. This is natural
cumulative behavior, is recorded in the growth manifest, and shifts only
confidence/recency tie-breaks; dry retrieval diagnostics (section 7) are
computed on the grown dump so evaluation sees one consistent KB. No other
pre-existing fragment is touched unless replay-failure counters fire during
growth (recorded if so).

## 3. Frozen constants (identical for every arm; NO threshold tuning)

TAU=0.30 MIN_MATCH=2 COV_CAP=6 TOPK=3 DF_KEEP=0.6 MIN_SITE_FRAGS=3
CONF_MIN=0.35 SEED=20260824 MAX_APPLICATIONS=6 MAX_RESETS=2
health floors dom_bytes>=2000 elements>=5; consumer agent=agentB;
allow_hints=False; query_mode="desc_only" for EVERY arm; passes=2.
None of these may change in response to any observed outcome. Any deviation
labels affected rows EXPLORATORY (cannot support confirmation).

## 4. Evaluation composites (frozen NOW; description strings deferred)

Composite skeletons are frozen here. CONSUMER-FACING DESCRIPTION STRINGS for
every subgoal key marked [T] are supplied VERBATIM by the third-authorship
CONFIRM instrument (`graph/paraphrases_scaling_confirm.json`) committed
BEFORE any growth run; they may never be edited afterwards. Keywords are []
for all [T] subgoals (desc_only is the only mode; disclosed). D2Q reuses the
cycle-3 composite C2 VERBATIM (descriptions included) as a replication
control with known-good addressing (its descs are near-duplicates of
training text — disclosed; it anchors the bottom of the depth ladder and
supports no addressing claim).

Acceptance predicates are path-anchored (`graph/accept.py`,
`url_matches_anchor`) plus explicit region predicates defined in
`graph/tasks_scaling.py` and covered by the trap suite (section 8):
- ROOT_Q(u): normalized path == "/" (accept.norm_path)
- ROOT_B(u): normalized path in {"/", "/index.html"}
- LOGGEDIN(s): element text "logout" visible; LOGGEDOUT(s): "login" visible
  and no "logout".

- q.logout [T]: ROOT_Q(u) AND LOGGEDOUT(s) / LOGOUT

Depth metric counts DISTINCT FRAGMENT CLASSES (section 4.6), so D5Q is the
deeper level even though PAGER-Q is applied twice — iteration of one
fragment never counted as depth (accepted frontier wording, G-H3/G-H4).

### 4.6 Distinctness definition (frozen)

Two stored fragments are the SAME CLASS iff their step sequences are
identical as ordered (kind, target_sig) pairs. Class map (closed):
AUTH=[click a|||||login, fill input|text||username|form-control|,
fill input|password||password|form-control, click submit btn-primary],
PAGER-Q/PAGER-B=[click a|||||next], TAG=[click a||||tag|love],
HOME-Q=[click a|||||quotes-to-scrape], LOGOUT=[click a|||||logout],
CAT-B=[click a|||||mystery], OPENBOOK-B=[click a|||||],
HOME-B=[click a|||||books-to-scrape].
Rationale: counting mere goal_sig identity would let parameterized
duplicates (e.g. two category fragments) inflate depth — the inflationary
reading an auditor must reject (audit items 4/7). Nominal composite depth =
class count of its subgoal list (table above). ACHIEVED memory-depth of a
row = number of DISTINCT classes among subgoals whose row-attribution is
memory-solved; reported per row alongside the nominal depth.

### 4.7 Carryover discipline

Every subgoal's accept is evaluated on the incoming state FIRST
(session carry-over semantics inherited from explorer). The skeleton above
was checked pairwise: no subgoal is satisfied by the end-state of its
predecessor's intended solution region except where stated (none). The trap
suite asserts this statically (section 8).

## 5. Growth phase (producer runs; closed task list)

Producer = Explorer agentB, allow_hints=True (producer side only),
evaluation=False (writes enabled — this is knowledge acquisition), health
gates on. Tasks (closed; no task may be added after any growth outcome):

- GB1_books_home: site books; start =
  https://books.toscrape.com/catalogue/category/books/mystery_3/index.html ;
  ONE subgoal sig `books.home`: ROOT_B(u); keywords ["home"].
  Expected validated fragment: [click a|||||books-to-scrape].
- GQ1_quotes_home: site quotes; start = QUOTES + "page/4/" ; ONE subgoal
  sig `quotes.home`: ROOT_Q(u); keywords ["home"].
  Expected fragment: [click a|||||quotes-to-scrape].
- GQ2_quotes_logout: site quotes; start = QUOTES root; TWO subgoals:
  (1) sig `quotes.login` (EXISTS; revalidation disclosed in section 2),
  LOGGEDIN(s), fills spiderbot/notasecret carried verbatim as task data;
  (2) sig `quotes.logout` (NEW): ROOT_Q(u) AND LOGGEDOUT(s);
  keywords ["logout"].
  DISCLOSURE: logout necessarily requires an authenticated session, so the
  login procedure appears as producer prep in the same trajectory. The pair
  (login-prep, logout) is NOT an adjacent pair of any composite (adjacent
  pairs enumerated in section 6), and the logout skill is validated as a
  SINGLE-subgoal unit.

Growth-phase stop rule: execute each task AT MOST TWICE; a task failing its
own acceptance twice stops growth (no improvised replacements). The grown
dump is emitted regardless; missing fragments make the affected composites
non-expressible and the cycle reports that fact (PARTIAL-by-expressibility)
instead of redesigning.

Contamination telemetry (over and above the binding gates): during EVERY
growth action the driver records the boolean satisfaction vector of ALL
section-4 composite subgoals on the live snapshot ("marker matrix"), shipped
in `results/graph/scaling_growth_manifest.json`. These markers feed section
6 and are disclosure artifacts only; producers do not read them.

## 6. Route-absence / contamination gates (binding)

- G1 TASK-LEVEL ADJACENT-PAIR (binding, extends cycle-2 precedent to the
  multi-composite setting): for every growth task and every composite C,
  there exist NO consecutive growth subgoals whose END-states satisfy
  C.pos_j and C.pos_{j+1} respectively (j, j+1 adjacent positions, in
  order). Verified mechanically from recorded end-of-subgoal markers by
  `graph/check_scaling_gates.py`. Expected result (predeclared): PASS for
  GB1/GQ1 (single-subgoal) and GQ2 ((login-end -> pos1-like states) and
  (logout-end -> pos6-like states) are non-adjacent in every composite).
- G2 STATE-LEVEL MARKER MATRIX (disclosure): the full per-action matrix is
  shipped; PREDECLARED incidental coincidences to be found in it:
  GQ1's final logged-out root satisfies D5Q's logout position; GQ2's
  mid-states satisfy D4Q/D5Q home and login positions; GB1's start state
  satisfies D3B/D4B's cat position and its end state the home position.
  No growth TRAJECTORY may contain two ADJACENT composite positions
  satisfied by consecutive states; if any is found, that composite's rows
  are labeled EXPLORATORY and cannot support confirmation.
- G3 FRAGMENT-GRAIN ASSERTION (binding): every stored fragment after growth
  has <= 4 steps and its step sequence traverses at most ONE composite
  accept-region boundary; verified by static inspection code
  (`check_scaling_gates.py` replays each fragment's (kind,target_sig)
  sequence against the composite predicates applied to URL-region
  signatures recorded per growth action). Additionally the WHOLE-TASK
  absence of every composite from all growth trajectories holds by
  construction (all growth tasks are single-region; asserted).
- G4 EQUIPMENT FREEZE: V31 equipment is FIXED standard equipment (program
  decision licensed by G-H4 integration limits); NO quantitative claim
  about V31 or any successor addressing construction is made, attempted,
  or licensed by this cycle; the cycle-4 fresh instrument remains SPENT and
  is not consulted anywhere.

## 7. Third-authorship instruments (protocol, frozen)

All new-composite consumer queries ([T] slots of sections 4.2–4.5) are
authored by TWO isolated subagent sessions (dev role, confirm role),
following the cycle-4 isolated-author protocol
(`graph/paraphrase_prompt_confirm_cycle4.md` precedent): neutral benchmark
semantics only (site type, target region, ordering context, credentials as
bare task data); instruction to vary vocabulary and sentence shape; NO
access to repo, corpus descriptions, scorer, or store. Prompts committed
verbatim as `graph/paraphrase_prompt_scaling_{dev,confirm}.md`.
AUTHORSHIP LIMITATION (disclosed up front): same-lab model-family
authorship, instructional isolation only, NOT human-independent; relation
to prior author sessions unverifiable. Producing-agent contact with the
files before commit is limited to structural JSON validation (key set,
field names, non-emptiness) — sanctioned and disclosed.
- CONFIRM instrument `graph/paraphrases_scaling_confirm.json`: maps every
  [T] subgoal key to THE description string used at evaluation. Frozen by
  commit BEFORE any growth run; never edited thereafter.
- DEV instrument `graph/paraphrases_scaling_dev.json`: one alternate
  paraphrase per key, used ONLY for offline sensitivity diagnostics
  (section 8). Can never confirm anything.
Offline dry diagnostics `graph/score_scaling_dry.py`: for every arm
equipment (V31 and legacy; fragment-layer and edge-layer mappings per
section 8.1) and every composite subgoal query (confirm + dev strings),
compute ranked candidates against the GROWN DUMP (offline reconstruction,
confidence filter disabled exactly as in score_variants.py). Output
committed BEFORE the live batch; purely REPORTED (non-gating); no rewriting
of any instrument permitted after its commit regardless of what the dry
scores show.

## 8. Arms, equalization, wiring constraints

### 8.1 Arm grid (COMPLETE and CLOSED at this commit)

All arms: agentB, allow_hints=False, query_mode="desc_only",
evaluation=True (writes NOTHING), byte-restored grown KB before every run,
health gate at entry and after every reset, MAX_APPLICATIONS=6,
MAX_RESETS=2, identical accept-oracle access (checked after every executed
action/application identically), identical exploration fallback code path,
SEED identical. Inheritance arms (memory-consuming):
- A1 frag_v31: condition inherit, blind=True, variant_ranker=
  make_variant_ranker("d3","q1") [V31 equipment; descriptor rule applies to
  fragment descriptions; df-pruning adapts to the grown KB].
- A2 frag_legacy: condition inherit, blind=True, variant_ranker=None
  (legacy goalsig.rank_fragments; equipment ablation).
- A3 giter_v31: condition graphiter with edge_ranker hook applying the
  FROZEN equipment-transfer mapping: query tokens via q_tokens("q1", text);
  edge token sets slug_tokens(target_sig)|{kind} transformed by the SAME
  symmetric canonicalization (_tok_transform canon=True ord_ext=False);
  scoring/ranking/tie-breaks/rng consumption identical to
  graph_iter.rank_edges. The d3 LIST descriptor rule is NOT applicable to
  edges (edges carry no descriptions) — this asymmetry is part of the
  frozen mapping and disclosed.
- A4 giter_legacy: condition graphiter, legacy rank_edges.
Reference arms:
- R1 cold: condition "cold" (no memory read; exploration only).
- R2 traj: condition "traj" (nearest-trajectory verbatim replay over the
  grown KB; desc_only query).

Tasks x arms x passes = 5 x 6 x 2 = 60 rows. Attempt budget: each cell
executed exactly once per pass; NO retries. Batch invalidation: if >20% of
rows end unhealthy_host/error, the batch is MEASUREMENT_INVALID and ONE full
rerun is permitted; a second such outcome records MEASUREMENT_INVALID for
the cycle (directive stop rule: two consecutive MEASUREMENT_INVALID =>
BLOCKED).

### 8.2 Additive instrumentation (pre-outcome, inert-by-default; disclosed)

Explorer gains ONLY: (a) optional `edge_ranker=None` parameter (None ==
exact legacy path, mirroring the audited variant_ranker pattern);
(b) recording of the SOLVED candidate's goal_sig into the memory event on
replay success (`event["solved_candidate"]`) and the solving edge for
graphiter/edgeseq (`event["solved_edge"]`); (c) a parallel
`time.perf_counter` retrieval timing field `retrieval_us` (integer-ms
`retrieval_ms` fields stay untouched and continue to support NO latency
claim; the new field exists for hygiene only — this cycle makes NO latency
or wall-clock claim of any kind). Legacy behaviors must remain bit-identical
(full suite green before any live run; explicit equivalence tests).

### 8.3 Trap suite (extends `tests/test_graph_cycle3.py` discipline)

New tests must cover AT LEAST: "/page/3" rejects ".../page/30/" and
accepts "/page/3/"; "page-2" rejects "page-20.html"/"travel_2";
"/tag/love" accepts "/tag/love/" and "/tag/love/page/1/" but rejects
"/tag/lack-of-love/"; ROOT_Q/ROOT_B accept only root paths; q.home rejects
logged-out root; q.logout rejects logged-in root; b.book rejects category
pages; carryover static check (section 4.7); distinctness/class-map unit
tests; edge_ranker None-equivalence bit-exactness; solved-candidate
recording presence; G1/G3 checker unit tests on synthetic matrices.

## 9. Analysis plan (frozen; `graph/analyze_scaling.py`)

Recomputed FROM RAW ROWS only:
1. Primary decision rule (directive text operationalized EXACTLY):
   memory_led(row) := status=="success" AND reused>novel (whole-row action
   counts as recorded by the explorer; resets already counted inside both).
   - SCALING-HOLDS iff SOME inheritance arm A has
     qualify_count(A) >= ceil(3/2)=2, where qualify_count(A) = number of
     D in {D4B, D4Q, D5Q} with memory_led(A,D,pass) for BOTH passes, AND
     for every qualifying (A,D) and BOTH passes the REFERENCE CONTRAST
     holds: status(cold,D,p) != "success" OR novel(cold,D,p) >
     novel(A,D,p); AND the same clause for traj. (If traj were to solve
     depth>=4 chains memory-led at lower novel cost, HOLDS would be
     hollow; the conjunction guards this. Traj per-task results are
     reported regardless.)
   - SCALING-COLLAPSE iff NO inheritance arm reaches memory_led on ANY
     depth>=4 composite in ANY pass, AND at least one depth>=4 composite
     is solvable-evidenced: cold or traj reaches end-to-end success on it
     (any pass), OR the recorded events attribute failures to compounding
     resets/entry mismatch (reset chains, entry-region abort patterns).
   - Otherwise: PARTIAL — report the exact success-by-depth pattern
     (which depths, arms, passes, mechanisms).
   The program's decision horizon is reached under EVERY branch; no
   successor depth experiment exists inside this program.
2. Depth-ladder table: per task x arm: rows memory-led / 2 (row
   convention), cells memory-led / 1 (cell convention, n=2 passes),
   achieved memory-depth distribution.
3. MANDATORY attribution table (unit: row x subgoal): solved_by
   {carryover, memory, exploration, unsolved}; for memory: solved
   candidate goal_sig + class; for empty candidate lists: ADDRESSING-MISS;
   candidates present but replay failed: EXECUTION-FAIL with abort_step;
   resets used; applications used. Mechanism separation (a)-(e) of
   section 1 computed from this table.
4. Novel-action cost comparison per task: inheritance arms vs cold vs traj
   (matched tasks; no cross-task aggregation).
5. Discipline proofs: distinct store_before across eval runs == 1;
   store_after stats == kb_at_eval_start stats for every run; final store
   stats equal eval-start stats (evaluation wrote nothing); pass1==pass2
   equality per cell on status/action counts/solved_by (reported; live-site
   nondeterminism would be investigated and disclosed, never silently
   averaged); health-gate events listed; preflight probes recorded.
6. Dry-retrieval sensitivity summary from section 7 (reported; dev role).
Denominators ALWAYS carry units (rows / cells / passes / subgoals) and are
never silently conditioned on end-to-end success (audit item 22).

Report `reports/graph/inheritance_scaling_cycle1.md`: headline with

NASTY on her kneecap, BABYDOLL on her leg Since WICKED above her hipbone, GIRL across her heart Words are like a road map to reporter Camille Preaker\u2019s troubled past. Fresh from a brief stay at a psych hospital, Camille\u2019s first assignment from the second-rate daily paper where she works brings her reluctantly back to her hometown to cover the murders of two preteen girls. NASTY on her kneecap, BABYDOLL on her leg Since she left town eight years ago, Camille has hardly spoken to her neurotic, hypochondriac mother or to the half-sister she barely knows: a beautiful thirteen-year-old with an eerie grip on the town. Now, installed again in her family\u2019s Victorian mansion, Camille is haunted by the childhood tragedy she has spent her whole life trying to cut from her memory. HARMFUL on her wrist, WHORE on her ankle As Camille works to uncover the truth about these violent crimes, she finds herself identifying with the young victims\u2014a bit too strongly. Clues keep leading to dead ends, forcing Camille to unravel the psychological puzzle of her own past to get at the story. NASTY on her kneecap, BABYDOLL on her leg Since she left town eight years ago, Camille has hardly spoken to her neurotic, hypochondriac mother or to the half-sister she barely knows: a beautiful thirteen-year-old with an eerie grip on the town. "x": 683, "y": 2231, "enabled": true}], "forms": [], "n_links": 74, "page_text": "Quotes to Scrape Logout \u201cThis life is what you make it. No matter what, you're going to mess up sometimes, it's a universal truth. But the good part is you get to decide how you're going to mess it up. Girls will be your friends - they'll act like it anyway. But just remember, some come, some go. The ones that stay with you through everything - they're your true best friends. Don't let go of them. Also remember, sisters make the best friends in the world. As for lovers, well, they'll come and go too. And baby, I hate to say it, most of them - actually pretty much all of them are going to break your heart, but you can't give up because if you give up, you'll never find your soulmate. You'll never find that half who makes you whole and that goes for everything. Just because you fail once, doesn't mean you're gonna fail at everything. Keep trying, hold on, and always, always, always believe in yourself, because if you don't, then who will, sweetie? So keep your head high, keep your chin up, and most importantly, keep smiling, because life's a beautiful thing and there's so much to smile about.\u201d by Marilyn Monroe (about) - (Goodreads page) Tags: friends heartbreak inspirational life love sisters \u201cIt takes a great deal of bravery to stand up to our enemies, but just as much to stand up to our friends.\u201d by J.K. Rowling (about) - (Goodreads page) Tags: courage friends \u201cIf you can't explain it to a six year old, you don't understand it yourself.\u201d by Albert Einstein (about) - (Goodreads page) Tags: simplicity understand \u201cYou may not be her first, her last, or her only. She loved before she may love again. But if she loves you now, what else matters? She's not perfect\u2014you aren't either, and the two of you may never be perfect together but if she can make you laugh, cause you to think twice, and admit to being human and making mistakes, hold onto her and give her the most you can. She may not be thinking about you every second of the day, but she will give you a part of her that she knows you can break\u2014her heart. So don't hurt her, don't change her, don't analyze and don't expect more than she can give. Smile when she makes you happy, let her know when she makes you mad, and miss her when she's not there.\u201d by Bob Marley (about) - (Goodreads page) Tags: love \u201cI like nonsense, it wakes up the brain cells.
